meta.size_basis: Sizes are what the Compose code asks for (fixed dp where written; a ~ value is an estimate from padding and text size; '(M3 default)' where Material 3 supplies it; 'wrap'/'fill' otherwise). They are NOT measured on a device. Region and order are reading order on a 412 dp wide phone.
meta.reference_frame: 412 x 892 dp, edge-to-edge, light theme only

region_vocabulary.header: fixed at the top, does not scroll
region_vocabulary.body: main area, scrolls if it overflows (except where noted)
region_vocabulary.footer: fixed at the bottom, does not scroll

status_values: merged (combined into another id; say which)
split (one became several; list the new ids in added_elements)
replaced (different control for the same function; say which)
meta.how_to_fill: For every element set redesign.status. For anything not 'removed' fill new_screen, new_region, new_order, new_width, new_height, new_style. Put brand-new elements in added_elements (id prefix = screen id). Never reuse an id for a different function. Leave new_text null unless the copy changes.

redesign_round.about: Filled in by the Claude Design round for ticket #190, 2026-10-27. Sizes and regions are measured from the rendered frames in annotated/ (412 x 892 dp).

decisions.navigation: Re-skin plus layout rework, same flow and same 9 routes; a top app bar was added
decisions.timing: Design started from the inventory and the live Web app; baseline frames (#189) were not available, so sizes are estimates of today's app

redesign_round.status_note: redesign.status holds the first word of status_values (kept, restyled, moved, merged, split, removed, replaced). Added elements carry "added".

elements.name: Title
elements.text:
Experimental Tool —
Not for Safety Decisions

elements.name: First paragraph
elements.text: RigCheck is an experimental project built to learn app development, not a certified or professional weight-safety tool. You type in numbers straight off your own tag and ticket photos, and the math that follows is simplified — any step of that chain can be wrong.

redesign.notes: Disclaimer wording is legally reviewed and unchanged. Drawn in disclaimer__default.png.

elements.name: Second paragraph
elements.function: Says do not use for safety decisions.
elements.text: Do not use this tool to decide whether your rig is safe to tow. Always verify actual weights and ratings using a certified scale and your vehicle's official documentation, and consult a qualified professional if you're unsure. You use this tool, and any decisions you make based on it, entirely at your own risk and responsibility.

redesign.notes: Disclaimer wording is legally reviewed and unchanged. Drawn in disclaimer__default.png.
